rules.title: Deprecated TLS version observed
rules.rationale: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are obsolete and vulnerable to known cryptographic weaknesses.
rules.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and require TLS 1.2 or preferably TLS 1.3.

rules.title: Weak TLS cipher suite observed
rules.rationale: RSA key transport and CBC/SHA-1-era suites do not meet modern TLS policy.
rules.remediation: Prefer TLS 1.3 or ECDHE with AEAD cipher suites.

rules.title: Static RSA key exchange observed
rules.rationale: Static RSA does not provide forward secrecy.
rules.remediation: Enable ECDHE or TLS 1.3 cipher suites and disable RSA key transport.

rules.title: Expired X.509 certificate observed
rules.rationale: An expired certificate cannot establish a currently valid identity.
rules.remediation: Replace the certificate and verify the full certificate chain.

rules.title: Weak RSA public key observed
rules.rationale: RSA keys below 2048 bits are below modern security-strength recommendations.
rules.remediation: Replace the certificate with an RSA key of at least 2048 bits.

rules.title: Weak certificate signature algorithm observed
rules.rationale: MD5 and SHA-1 are collision-prone and unsuitable for certificate signatures.
rules.remediation: Reissue the certificate using a SHA-256-or-stronger signature algorithm.

rules.title: Certificate is not yet valid
rules.rationale: The certificate validity period has not begun.
rules.remediation: Correct the certificate validity period and verify system time.

rules.title: Certificate does not match TLS SNI
rules.rationale: The observed certificate identity does not cover the hostname requested by the client.
rules.remediation: Deploy a certificate whose SAN includes the mail service hostname.

rules.title: Weak elliptic-curve group observed
rules.rationale: The negotiated group provides less than 112 bits of security.
rules.remediation: Require X25519, secp256r1, secp384r1, or a stronger approved group.
